title: Vault workflows and connector status
description: Explore Vault workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.
html:
SoftwareUpcoming

Autodesk

Vault

Autodesk Vault manages CAD data, versions, relationships and engineering change processes.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Locate related design files

Start from the controlled identifier, current revision and relationship context. In the intended Vault preview, locate related design files; the visible result is the matching record, document or model tree with ownership visible. Review source system, revision, permissions and record identity before accepting or exporting it.

Create a controlled revision

Begin with the proposed change, exchange or coordination package. In the intended Vault preview, create a controlled revision; the visible result is a versioned change set with affected objects and approvals exposed. Review scope, dependencies, recipients and comparison accuracy before accepting or exporting it.

Review change history

Use the release, transmittal or review criteria. In the intended Vault preview, review change history; the visible result is a traceable status view with history and outstanding decisions. Review approvers, effective revision, audit trail and delivery state before accepting or exporting it.
